purpose: taxids for 20 names by qualified label ("Name <qualifier>"), batch 2
sparql: PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX obo: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/> SELECT ?t ?l WHERE { ?t rdfs:label ?l . FILTER(REGEX(STR(?t),'NCBITaxon_[0-9]+$')) FILTER(REGEX(STR(?l), "^(Danionidae|Danio|Acanthomorphata|Acanthopterygii|Percomorphaceae|Ovalentaria|Atherinomorphae|Beloniformes|Belonoidei|Exocoetidae|Adrianichthyidae|Oryzias|Liparidae|Sarcopterygii|Dipnotetrapodomorpha|Tetrapoda|Amphibia|Anura|Xenopus|Amniota) <[^>]*>$")) }
